tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | Job ID: 116016
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years of professional experience building, extending, and supporting enterprise e-commerce platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), Java, and Spring Boot. Proven delivery of RESTful APIs, OCC web services, and integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Strong expertise in database query optimization, backoffice customization, and CI/CD workflows on CCv2. Experienced in techno-functional roles driving requirements analysis, process mapping, and agile delivery.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: E-Commerce Developer - Job ID: 116016
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the E-Commerce position (Job ID: 116016) at Compest Solutions Inc. With over 5 years of hands-on experience developing, extending, and integrating enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in Java, Spring Boot, and e-commerce platform architectures.

bullets.label: Enterprise E-Commerce Platforms
bullets.text: Delivered robust backend e-commerce capabilities on SAP Commerce Cloud (2105 & 2211), covering catalog management, Order Management (OMS), Backoffice customization, and Promotions Engine.

bullets.label: API & Integration Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and exposed headless OCC REST web services and built scalable data pipelines linking PIM, ERP, and MDM platforms (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) for synchronized product workflows.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Analysis
bullets.text: Collaborated with business stakeholders and international technical teams to translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, and technical designs.

bullets.label: Platform Tuning & DevOps
bullets.text: Refactored database queries to reduce latency and executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) within agile delivery environments.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day of 15 December 2026 and an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience can support Compest Solutions Inc.'s client goals.

tailoring.why_company: Compest Solutions Inc. stands out for delivering high-impact e-commerce engineering across major platform architectures. With over 5 years of enterprise experience in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and complex PIM/ERP integrations, I am eager to contribute to your consulting practice, bringing strong technical execution and business analysis capabilities to your client initiatives.
tailoring.motivation_short: E-Commerce backend developer with 5+ years of experience in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, and API integrations. Passionate about delivering scalable e-commerce solutions and bridging business requirements with technical delivery at Compest Solutions Inc.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I noticed the E-Commerce opening (Job ID: 116016) at Compest Solutions Inc. With 5+ years in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, and PIM/ERP integrations, I would love to connect and discuss how my technical background aligns with your team's goals.
tailoring.offer: I offer immediate expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud development, OCC REST web services, and enterprise PIM/ERP integration pipelines to drive seamless client solutions. My techno-functional background also enables me to effectively bridge business requirements and technical design for efficient release delivery.
tailoring.insight: The role emphasizes enterprise e-commerce platform integration across complex ecosystems; my background in constructing OCC REST APIs and synchronization pipelines for SAP ERP and Profisee PIM directly addresses these platform integration needs.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: E-Commerce Developer - Job ID: 116016 - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the E-Commerce role (Job ID: 116016) at Compest Solutions Inc. With over five years of experience in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and Spring Boot, I specialize in building scalable REST APIs and integrating PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Compest Solutions Inc.'s commitment to enterprise commerce solutions fits my background in platform optimization and techno-functional consulting.

My attached CV and cover letter detail my experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Serving my notice period until 15 December 2026, I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can add immediate value to your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
